classes.name: Warrior
classes.baseline: Rage comes from validated martial generators; receiving damage grants no baseline Rage. Guard and other specialization meters follow their explicit resource contracts.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.baseline: Conviction is generated by validated holy-martial actions and has a limited cap.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.weakness: Heavy physical pressure and spell interruption.
classes.baseline: Devotion is earned by valid healing, protection and sacred offensive interactions; no out-of-combat farming.

classes.name: Mage
classes.baseline: Mana spending and replenishment are deterministic; specialization-specific charges are additional.

classes.name: Necromancer
classes.baseline: Soul Essence is earned from applied abilities and capped events, never unlimited disposable minion loops.

classes.name: Bard
classes.weakness: Performance disruption and low passive defenses.
classes.baseline: Cadence builds from successful timed actions, not audio-device input or latency-dependent rhythm.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.weakness: Area damage exposure and vulnerability when pinned.
classes.baseline: Energy regenerates over time; combo points are per-target or class-state by explicit spec policy.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.baseline: Focus regenerates and is restored by certain aimed attacks; companions use bounded server AI.

classes.name: Druid
classes.baseline: Available form and resource are server-validated; all forms share common transformation lockout policy.

classes.name: Shaman
classes.baseline: Stormcharge is generated by qualifying elemental abilities; totems have ownership and active-object limits.

classes.name: Monk
classes.weakness: Ranged pressure and difficult timing windows.
classes.baseline: Energy regenerates; eligible martial actions generate Chi, which is capped and expires by explicit policy.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.weakness: Interrupted casts and dependency on pact decisions.
classes.baseline: Authority is generated by active validated combat; resource sacrifices never bypass minimum-health rules.

specializations.name: Bulwark
specializations.mechanic: Guard: successful blocks and protected allies generate Guard; spending Guard powers active mitigation.

playstyle.loop: Build Guard through actually blocked attacks; spend it on timed mitigation or a counterstrike. Face the next physical hit rather than holding one passive stance indefinitely.
playstyle.route_a: Mobile interception: preserve frontal defense while advancing and use Interpose to protect an ally who cannot move.
playstyle.route_b: Static defense: hold a small area, pool Guard and answer a predictable tank strike with a stronger personal response.
playstyle.tradeoff: Mobile protection loses some stationary mitigation; stationary specialization loses rescue reach. Neither removes baseline tanking.
playstyle.resource_contract: 100 Guard; +10 on a real block or effective interception, once per second; 25 for a defensive spend; lose 10/second after six seconds out of combat.

specializations.name: Armsmaster
specializations.mechanic: Opening: deliberate strikes create Exposed windows that empower carefully timed follow-ups.

playstyle.loop: Create up to three Openings with deliberate attacks; consume them on a high-value target while using parry windows selectively.
playstyle.route_a: Precision dueling: remain close, build Openings and delay the finisher for an exposed target.
playstyle.route_b: Reach and control: spend Openings on line pressure and movement disruption while switching targets.
playstyle.tradeoff: Focused timing raises priority-target output but reduces multi-target coverage; reach gives up peak single-target pressure.
playstyle.resource_contract: Three Openings per caster on the current target; primary generator adds one; spender uses one to three; eight-second duration, refreshed only by eligible hits.

specializations.name: Berserker
specializations.mechanic: Frenzy: repeated hits raise Frenzy; high stacks increase offense but expose greater risk.

playstyle.loop: Build Frenzy with connected weapon sequences, then decide between spending it on an area attack and sustaining a risky offensive window.
playstyle.route_a: Controlled aggression: smaller incoming-damage penalty and defensive recovery at high Frenzy.
playstyle.route_b: Pursuit aggression: chain short legal repositions and spend Frenzy during multi-target pressure.
playstyle.tradeoff: Safer offense sacrifices peak burst; pursuit needs uptime and takes more damage when careless.
playstyle.resource_contract: Five Frenzy; one per eligible weapon action, at most once per second; area spender consumes three; lose one every two seconds after four seconds without a hit.

specializations.name: Oathkeeper
specializations.mechanic: Oathmarks: protecting allies and standing inside sacred ground creates marks used for mitigation.

playstyle.loop: Generate Oathmarks through real protection and spend them on threat or mitigation; place defensive zones where the group can actually use them.
playstyle.route_a: Area protection: stay within a compact Vigil Circle and plan damage-reduction windows.
playstyle.route_b: Moving protection: redirect capped damage and move protection between allies instead of defending one location.
playstyle.tradeoff: Large area efficiency declines when the party moves; mobile rescue reduces personal stationary mitigation.
playstyle.resource_contract: Five Oathmarks; one for an eligible block/prevention event, once per second; spend two; no marks from standing idle in a zone.

specializations.name: Crusader
specializations.mechanic: Judgment Seals: holy weapon hits brand targets; Conviction consumes seals for empowered finishers.

playstyle.loop: Build Conviction and target Seals with weapon actions, then consume Seals on a prepared finisher.
playstyle.route_a: Single-target verdict: maintain one marked opponent and concentrate resource spending.
playstyle.route_b: Sweeping judgment: spread marks through a cone and divide a spender across several opponents.
playstyle.tradeoff: Target focus loses cleave; spreading loses priority-target peak damage and takes setup.
playstyle.resource_contract: 100 Conviction shared with class; +10 eligible generator; three target Seals maximum; finisher spends 30 Conviction and available Seals.

specializations.name: Justicar
specializations.mechanic: Testament: successful heals and righteous blows build Testament for powerful restorative acts.

playstyle.loop: Alternate targeted recovery with optional close-range holy attacks; reserve Testament for expensive recovery windows.
playstyle.route_a: Melee-assisted healing: earn Testament from safe weapon contact between heals.
playstyle.route_b: Ranged protection: remain with vulnerable allies and build through effective healing instead.
playstyle.tradeoff: Melee contribution risks positional exposure; ranged play gives up martial damage and accelerated resource generation.
playstyle.resource_contract: Five Testament; one from an effective primary heal or eligible attack while an ally is injured, once per second; spend three on group recovery. Mana sustains healing.

specializations.name: High Priest
specializations.mechanic: Devotion: varied direct heals produce Devotion, increasing efficiency of major group healing.

playstyle.loop: Use inexpensive direct healing for routine damage, preserve Devotion for group recovery and keep emergency healing available.
playstyle.route_a: Efficient recovery: use varied small heals and time the larger prayer for predictable group damage.
playstyle.route_b: Emergency recovery: hold resources and a burst heal for a threatened target, accepting higher mana use.
playstyle.tradeoff: Efficient preparation has less instant recovery; emergency specialization is less sustainable.
playstyle.resource_contract: Five Devotion; one per effective heal of a different ability family from the previous qualifying heal; spend three on group healing; Mana remains the primary budget.

specializations.name: Oracle
specializations.mechanic: Foresight Tokens: predictive wards grant tokens when attacks are prevented; tokens enable anticipatory remedies.

playstyle.loop: Place wards before damage and earn Foresight only when they prevent real damage; spend it on the next predicted danger.
playstyle.route_a: Concentrated forecasting: protect one marked recipient with larger timed wards.
playstyle.route_b: Distributed forecasting: divide protection among several allies before an area pulse.
playstyle.tradeoff: Single-target wards waste value when damage changes targets; distributed wards are weaker on a tank spike.
playstyle.resource_contract: Five Foresight; one per consumed shield event above 1% recipient maximum health, once per second; spend three; no resource for unused or refreshed wards.

specializations.name: Inquisitor
specializations.mechanic: Testimony: sacred damage places evidence marks; consuming marks produces stronger judgments.

playstyle.loop: Apply evidence marks through sacred attacks, then choose when to consume them for a verdict.
playstyle.route_a: Sustained testimony: keep marks active and use measured single-target casts.
playstyle.route_b: Area testimony: use a witness field and consume marks on clustered opponents.
playstyle.tradeoff: Sustained damage has slower burst; area specialization loses efficiency on isolated enemies.
playstyle.resource_contract: Three evidence marks per caster/target; primary direct hit adds one; finisher consumes all; 12-second expiry.

specializations.name: Pyromancer
specializations.mechanic: Heat: fiery attacks accumulate Heat and Burning; spend Heat on controlled ignition events.

playstyle.loop: Build Heat while applying Burning; decide between consuming Heat now and preserving setup for a later detonation.
playstyle.route_a: Ignition burst: consume Heat and selected Burning on one priority target; reapply the burn afterward.
playstyle.route_b: Sustained combustion: preserve Burning and spend Heat on limited spreading/area pressure.
playstyle.tradeoff: Detonation creates stronger short windows but downtime afterward; sustained play needs targets to live and remain reachable.
playstyle.resource_contract: 100 Heat; Kindling Spear +10, Flash Ember +5 on valid hits; ordinary spender costs 30; major finisher consumes available Heat above 30; no gain from consumed remaining DoT damage.

specializations.name: Frostbinder
specializations.mechanic: Chill: frost effects accumulate Chill; threshold freezes minor enemies, while bosses receive a non-control vulnerability.

playstyle.loop: Apply Chill, then choose between consuming it for damage and maintaining space with slows and areas.
playstyle.route_a: Focused shatter: consume Chill frequently for direct damage against a priority target.
playstyle.route_b: Zone control: retain Chill pressure and invest in larger, weaker control fields.
playstyle.tradeoff: Shatter loses persistent control; zoning loses immediate single-target output. Bosses receive the authored damage alternative instead of roots.
playstyle.resource_contract: Five Chill per caster/target; primary frost hit adds one, at most once per action; finisher consumes three; ten-second expiry; root follows global diminishing returns.

specializations.name: Arcanist
specializations.mechanic: Arcane Charges: structured casting builds charges; spending them changes spell outputs and mana economy.

playstyle.loop: Build Arcane Charges with Glyph Bolt and trade burst against rapidly increasing mana cost when spending charges.
playstyle.route_a: Charged burst: accumulate four charges, then release Charge Lance from a prepared position.
playstyle.route_b: Efficient circulation: spend one or two charges, recover mana between windows and favor limited mobile follow-ups.
playstyle.tradeoff: Maximum charges improve burst but consume mana disproportionately; frequent smaller spends reduce peak output.
playstyle.resource_contract: Four Arcane Charges; Glyph Bolt +1; Charge Lance consumes selected 1–4 charges; damage 0.8P +0.35P per charge, mana cost 3% +2% per charge; charges expire after ten seconds out of combat.

specializations.name: Gravecaller
specializations.mechanic: Command Capacity: choose between elite undead and multiple lesser undead with bounded server entity cost.

playstyle.loop: Allocate one summon-capacity pool and command coordinated attacks; resources come from successful combat, not dismiss/resummon loops.
playstyle.route_a: Single sovereign: one elite controlled servant, fewer commands and concentrated target pressure.
playstyle.route_b: March of bones: up to four lesser servants with divided output and coordinated positional coverage.
playstyle.tradeoff: Elite control is vulnerable to disabling one pet; a squad costs more attention and has weaker individuals, not four full pet budgets.
playstyle.resource_contract: Four capacity units; elite costs four, lesser costs one; all sources share the same aggregate pet budget. Commands cost 20 Soul Essence; basic owner attacks generate 10, once per action.

specializations.name: Plaguebringer
specializations.mechanic: Contagion: sustained disease application builds Contagion for controlled spreading and consumption.

playstyle.loop: Maintain diseases, collect bounded Contagion from actual ticks and choose between extending, spreading and consuming them.
playstyle.route_a: Patient decay: longer diseases with preserved total-per-application budgeting and lower maintenance frequency.
playstyle.route_b: Rapid infection: shorter diseases and faster damage realization at greater mana and refresh pressure.
playstyle.tradeoff: Long effects lose value on short-lived targets; rapid infection is more demanding and easier to exhaust.
playstyle.resource_contract: 100 Contagion; +5 from a qualifying disease tick, global owner limit once per second; spread costs 25; acceleration costs 30; harvest consumes the selected target's remaining disease budget once.

specializations.name: Soulreaper
specializations.mechanic: Soul Essence: harvest Soul Essence and spend it on direct death magic and bounded life exchange.

playstyle.loop: Mark one enemy, build Essence through direct and channel attacks, then choose a spender or defensive reserve.
playstyle.route_a: Repeated extraction: smaller frequent spends and controlled life drain.
playstyle.route_b: Planned requiem: pool Essence for a telegraphed finisher while retaining enough for a ward.
playstyle.tradeoff: Frequent spending loses burst; pooling risks interruption and reduces immediate self-protection.
playstyle.resource_contract: 100 Soul Essence shared with class; marked direct hit +10, channel tick +5; ordinary spender 30; major spender 60; no resources from self-damage or friendly summons.

specializations.name: Minstrel
specializations.mechanic: Harmonies: maintain restorative phrases and build Cadence through effective healing and support.

playstyle.loop: Maintain up to two ordinary song slots, heal targets actively and spend Harmony on group recovery without requiring precise audio timing.
playstyle.route_a: Moving chorus: move with allies, use short restorative phrases and frequent song transitions.
playstyle.route_b: Prepared haven: establish longer recovery patterns and hold an emergency finale.
playstyle.tradeoff: Mobile healing trades peak sustained throughput; prepared healing loses value when allies scatter.
playstyle.resource_contract: Three Harmonies; +1 on an effective primary heal, at most once per second; group recovery consumes two and finale three. Mana is primary; Cadence is the performance meter.

specializations.name: Skald
specializations.mechanic: Battle Cadence: weapon strikes and rallying notes accumulate Cadence; spent Cadence fuels war songs.

playstyle.loop: Generate Cadence in melee, then choose personal finishing damage or a temporary group enhancement.
playstyle.route_a: Solo skald: more personal weapon output and reduced allied amplification.
playstyle.route_b: Battle chorus: spend more time and Cadence on measurable ally enhancement.
playstyle.tradeoff: Personal damage scales less with coordinated allies; group support performs poorly when allies cannot act. Neither route requires another player to complete solo content.
playstyle.resource_contract: 100 Cadence; Iron Verse +10 on contact; War Chant upkeep four/second, Thunderbeat cost 25, finisher 40; strongest-category group buff only.

specializations.name: Virtuoso
specializations.mechanic: Countermelody: offensive notes construct a sequence that resolves into controlled sonic bursts or debuffs.

playstyle.loop: Build a short sequence of offensive note families, then resolve it into a bounded sonic effect.
playstyle.route_a: Focused solo: narrow line attacks and direct single-target final notes.
playstyle.route_b: Echo control: use a field and disruptive notes to support clustered combat.
playstyle.tradeoff: Narrow attacks lose coverage; echo fields need positioning and cannot recursively repeat their own damage.
playstyle.resource_contract: Store the last three qualifying note-family IDs; repeated identical notes do not advance the sequence; resolving a finale clears it; maximum one weakened echo per original attack.

specializations.name: Assassin
specializations.mechanic: Venom Windows: poisoned targets become vulnerable to stealth openers and Combo Point finishers.

playstyle.loop: Prepare a poison/positioning window and spend Combo Points on a timed finisher rather than attacking from stealth indefinitely.
playstyle.route_a: Poison attrition: maintain poison, accept slower damage and use defensive re-entry windows.
playstyle.route_b: Opening burst: commit positional attacks and finish during a short marked weakness.
playstyle.tradeoff: Poison pressure is slower; burst is weaker when forced out of position or its opening is denied.
playstyle.resource_contract: Five Combo Points on the owner, not a target; eligible generator +1; finisher spends 1–5. Stealth itself grants no points and cannot be retoggled in combat to farm an opener.

specializations.name: Duelist
specializations.mechanic: Advantage: timed counters and uninterrupted weapon chains accumulate Advantage for precise finishers.

playstyle.loop: Alternate attacks with counters to build Advantage; spend it only when the exchange creates an opportunity.
playstyle.route_a: Counter specialist: read incoming attacks and turn a successful parry into a finisher.
playstyle.route_b: Mobile exchanges: build through varied weapon actions and short positional changes.
playstyle.tradeoff: Counter play loses value without incoming eligible attacks; mobile play gives up the strongest counter reward.
playstyle.resource_contract: Five Advantage; +2 from a successful active parry or +1 from two distinct qualifying attacks, once per second; finisher consumes three; no gain from self-created attacks.

specializations.name: Saboteur
specializations.mechanic: Prepared Devices: deploy a limited network of traps, smoke and timed explosives.

playstyle.loop: Place a small device set, control an approach and trigger it deliberately rather than spawning unrestricted traps.
playstyle.route_a: Prepared field: deploy fewer stronger devices and wait for enemies to enter the planned area.
playstyle.route_b: Mobile sabotage: use shorter-lived devices and reposition between activations.
playstyle.tradeoff: Prepared damage is avoidable by moving away; mobile devices have lower individual impact.
playstyle.resource_contract: Three active devices, separate from cosmetic objects but within the class combat-object ceiling; placement cost 20 Energy, trigger cost 10; each device triggers once.

specializations.name: Marksman
specializations.mechanic: Aim: stationary aiming builds focus precision; movement preserves some, but not all, aim.

playstyle.loop: Build Aim while stationary and consume it on measured shots; movement is permitted but has an explicit opportunity cost.
playstyle.route_a: Anchored marksman: hold position for stronger deliberate shots and planned narrow volleys.
playstyle.route_b: Mobile precision: preserve a limited amount of Aim through brief repositioning at reduced stationary bonuses.
playstyle.tradeoff: Anchoring is vulnerable to hazards and melee pressure; mobility sacrifices peak stationary damage.
playstyle.resource_contract: Three Aim; gain one per uninterrupted second preparing an attack, maximum three; moving removes one per second unless a talent permits limited retention; no random accuracy bonus.

specializations.name: Beastmaster
specializations.mechanic: Bond: coordinated actions with a single active bonded companion build Bond for commands.

playstyle.loop: Build Bond with successful owner/pet coordination and spend it on commands, while retaining functional owner attacks.
playstyle.route_a: Offensive bond: pet and owner focus one priority target with timed combined attacks.
playstyle.route_b: Guarding bond: use more commands for pet interception and protection while reducing direct pet offense.
playstyle.tradeoff: Offense loses defensive command availability; guarding loses damage and cannot replace a player tank.
playstyle.resource_contract: 100 Bond; +10 when both owner and pet hit an eligible target within two seconds, once per two seconds; command costs 25; one active four-capacity companion.

specializations.name: Pathfinder
specializations.mechanic: Waypoints: agile movement and prepared traps create Waypoints that enhance ambushes and safe routes.

playstyle.loop: Combine a ranged attack, a close-range technique and traps with legal repositioning; select safe routes rather than permanent kiting immunity.
playstyle.route_a: Ambush route: plan traps and use short melee pressure when the target reaches them.
playstyle.route_b: Running route: prioritize mobile shots and defensive waypoints.
playstyle.tradeoff: Ambush requires preparation; running shots lose stationary and trap burst value.
playstyle.resource_contract: Three Waypoint charges; gain one after moving at least two units between two eligible attacks, once per three seconds; spend one for an enhanced follow-up; ordinary movement alone grants none.

specializations.name: Wildguard
specializations.mechanic: Ursine Resolve: the bear form generates Resolve from holding ground and mitigating damage.

playstyle.loop: Enter the tank form, generate Resolve through real defensive work and spend it before large incoming hits.
playstyle.route_a: Anchored bear: strong self-defense and controlled area threat while holding position.
playstyle.route_b: Mobile guardian: use defensive movement and ally coverage with reduced stationary mitigation.
playstyle.tradeoff: Anchoring is less flexible; mobile coverage gives up some personal defense. Humanoid utility does not preserve full tank mitigation.
playstyle.resource_contract: 100 Resolve; eligible mitigated enemy hit +10, maximum once per second; defensive spend 30; active tank form required; no resource from zero-damage friendly effects.

specializations.name: Feral
specializations.mechanic: Predatory Rhythm: cat-form strikes create Combo Points and open bleeding finishers.

playstyle.loop: Build Combo Points through claw attacks and decide between immediate finishing damage and maintained bleeds.
playstyle.route_a: Bleeding pursuit: maintain bleeds while moving between positional opportunities.
playstyle.route_b: Focused predation: spend more points in short direct windows against one target.
playstyle.tradeoff: Bleeds are slower on fragile enemies; direct windows require uptime and careful resource pooling.
playstyle.resource_contract: Energy plus five owner Combo Points; Raking Claw +1; Savage Finish consumes 1–5; form changes preserve no additional duplicate resource pool.

specializations.name: Grovekeeper
specializations.mechanic: Bloom: nature healing effects mature over time; applying new growth interacts with existing Blooms.

playstyle.loop: Apply growing healing seeds, decide when to consume a mature seed and position recovery areas before group damage.
playstyle.route_a: Sustained garden: maintain several HoTs and let them mature naturally.
playstyle.route_b: Reactive bloom: consume prepared seeds for immediate recovery, then spend time and mana replanting.
playstyle.tradeoff: Sustained healing is slower to rescue; consuming seeds trades future healing for current health.
playstyle.resource_contract: Three growth stages per seed at 0/4/8 seconds; one seed per caster/target; consuming removes that seed and its remaining healing budget; no duplicate tick at consumption.

specializations.name: Starcaller
specializations.mechanic: Cycle: alternating solar and lunar nature spells shifts a Cycle meter and empowers corresponding finishes.

playstyle.loop: Alternate solar and lunar spells to control a Cycle state, then release the appropriate spender.
playstyle.route_a: Alternating balance: use both spell families to maintain access to repeated balanced finishes.
playstyle.route_b: Committed phase: stay in one phase longer for stronger short output before an explicit recovery phase.
playstyle.tradeoff: Balance loses maximum phase burst; commitment is more vulnerable to target loss and forced movement.
playstyle.resource_contract: Cycle meter −3 to +3; solar adds one, lunar subtracts one; eligible finisher consumes three units toward zero; no benefit from toggling a phase without a successful action.

specializations.name: Stormcaller
specializations.mechanic: Stormcharge: alternating lightning and earth attacks builds charge for powerful releases.

playstyle.loop: Alternate elemental attacks and release Stormcharge through a line, field or priority-target strike.
playstyle.route_a: Focused discharge: pool for a high-value target with limited chaining.
playstyle.route_b: Distributed storm: spend through fields and capped chains against groups.
playstyle.tradeoff: Focus loses area output; field damage requires enemies to remain inside the area.
playstyle.resource_contract: 100 Stormcharge; alternating eligible elements +15, repeated element +5; spender 30; major discharge 60; one gain per root action, not per target.

specializations.name: Spiritmender
specializations.mechanic: Ancestral Threads: healing creates threads among allies; connected targets share part of later support.

playstyle.loop: Create temporary links with direct heals and choose a limited path for later recovery.
playstyle.route_a: Close kinship: heal a compact group through efficient short chain jumps.
playstyle.route_b: Focused memory: spend links on protection and direct recovery of threatened recipients.
playstyle.tradeoff: Chains lose value when allies spread; focused protection reduces group throughput.
playstyle.resource_contract: Maximum four linked allies per caster; a link lasts ten seconds; chain jumps within three units, maximum four targets; no target visited twice in one chain.

specializations.name: Totemist
specializations.mechanic: Totem Constellation: place a limited pattern of elemental totems; links produce contextual effects.

playstyle.loop: Allocate four static-object capacity units and define at most three links; placement and timing determine damage and support.
playstyle.route_a: Anchored constellation: retain a stable layout for sustained area effects.
playstyle.route_b: Portable pattern: relocate a smaller layout more often with lower peak output.
playstyle.tradeoff: Anchoring loses value against movement; portability sacrifices stationary uptime and throughput.
playstyle.resource_contract: Four total combat totems including shared-class totems; at most three explicit links; placement cost 4% mana; relocation follows its own cooldown and cannot duplicate old objects.

specializations.name: Ironbody
specializations.mechanic: Balance: shifting stance and predicting attacks builds Balance, spent to delay and mitigate damage.

playstyle.loop: Use a defensive stance to delay a bounded part of damage, then spend Balance to reduce the debt; delayed damage is still owed.
playstyle.route_a: Debt management: prepare mitigation and clear part of the ledger before a dangerous overlap.
playstyle.route_b: Reactive countering: earn Balance through timed defense and accept a smaller delayed-damage pool.
playstyle.tradeoff: A large ledger risks delayed death; reactive defense is less reliable when timing fails.
playstyle.resource_contract: 100 Balance; successful defense +10 once per second; 30 Balance clears 25% of current ledger; delay at most 30% of eligible post-absorb damage over six seconds; no re-delaying debt ticks.

specializations.name: Windfist
specializations.mechanic: Flow: distinct martial attacks maintain Flow; repeating the same move diminishes bonuses.

playstyle.loop: Alternate distinct martial actions to preserve Flow while generating and spending Chi.
playstyle.route_a: Sustained combinations: preserve varied chains and distribute spending.
playstyle.route_b: Burst sequences: build a short complete sequence and spend heavily on a bounded finisher.
playstyle.tradeoff: Sustained sequences lose peak burst; burst is punished by interruption and target loss.
playstyle.resource_contract: Five Chi; generator +1; finisher cost three; Flow is the last three distinct action families with a six-second window, not a second full energy bar.

specializations.name: Lifewalker
specializations.mechanic: Living Chi: martial hits and mindful spells generate Living Chi that turns movement into restoration.

playstyle.loop: Use direct recovery and close-range techniques to build Living Chi; choose whether entering melee is safe.
playstyle.route_a: Martial healing: gain extra Chi from safe attacks while an ally needs recovery.
playstyle.route_b: Protective meditation: heal at short range and preserve a stationary channel for predictable damage.
playstyle.tradeoff: Martial healing risks melee exposure; meditation loses damage contribution and mobility.
playstyle.resource_contract: Five Living Chi; effective primary heal +1; eligible martial action +1 only if an ally is injured; major heal costs three; Mana is the sustained resource.

specializations.name: Demonologist
specializations.mechanic: Pact Authority: direct a single important bound demon and earn Authority through coordinated commands.

playstyle.loop: Direct one major demon and build Authority through combined actions rather than unattended pet damage.
playstyle.route_a: Coordinated offense: plan owner/demon attacks and spend Authority in synchronized windows.
playstyle.route_b: Protective contract: use the same command budget for capped interception and wards.
playstyle.tradeoff: Offense sacrifices protection; protection reduces damage. Losing the demon disrupts both but does not remove the owner's basic spell.
playstyle.resource_contract: 100 Authority; owner and demon hit within two seconds grants 10, once per two seconds; combined attack spends 30; one four-capacity demon replaces the lesser summon.

specializations.name: Hellcaller
specializations.mechanic: Infernal Debt: destructive spells accrue Debt; controlled repayment causes explosive releases at personal cost.

playstyle.loop: Build Infernal Debt through attacks, then discharge it while managing a capped nonlethal personal cost.
playstyle.route_a: Controlled furnace: maintain a limited field and repay Debt frequently.
playstyle.route_b: Risked discharge: pool Debt for a larger attack with explicit health/defense exposure.
playstyle.tradeoff: Controlled repayment loses peak burst; larger debt risks death from enemy pressure even though the self-cost itself is nonlethal.
playstyle.resource_contract: 100 Debt; ordinary generator +10 once per action; discharge spends 30 or 60; self-payment capped at 10% maximum health and cannot take the caster below 35% maximum health.

specializations.name: Pactbinder
specializations.mechanic: Contracts: designate one active contractual clause that converts a particular cost into an offensive or utility reward.

playstyle.loop: Maintain one contract clause; create progress through paid, successful actions and decide when to settle it.
playstyle.route_a: Personal contract: spend more of the contract budget on individual damage.
playstyle.route_b: Shared liability: fund capped allied protection and debuffs at a personal-output cost.
playstyle.tradeoff: Personal output loses support; allied value depends on recipients acting and taking relevant damage.
playstyle.resource_contract: One active clause, five progress; paid eligible action adds one, at most once per second; settlement consumes all; changing clause clears progress; self-damage alone cannot generate more progress.

talents.name: Steelhand
talents.effect: Each rank improves the weapon-based damage of Iron Cut by 2%.

talents.name: Surefooted Charge
talents.effect: Each rank shortens Forward Rush recovery by 3%.

talents.name: Drilled Interruption
talents.effect: Each rank reduces Hilt Check's cooldown by 2% without extending control.

talents.name: Shared Courage
talents.effect: Each rank increases Rally Roar's benefit to allies by 2%.

talents.name: Intentional Footing
talents.effect: Primary action: Iron Cut. After moving at least one unit between successful primary actions, the next primary action gains 2% output per rank. Six-second internal cooldown; no movement-only trigger.

talents.name: Measured Recovery
talents.effect: Primary action: Iron Cut. The first eligible primary action after spending at least 20% of the main resource costs 3% less per rank. If it already costs zero, grant 1% output per rank instead; eight-second internal cooldown.

talents.name: Mobile Bulwark
talents.effect: Iron Brace allows slow movement without losing its protection.

talents.name: Weapon Rhythm
talents.effect: After Hilt Check, the next two weapon skills use shorter recoveries.

talents.name: Shared Resolve
talents.effect: Rally Roar also grants a minor barrier to injured nearby allies.

talents.name: Moving Commitment
talents.effect: Primary action: Iron Cut. After a successful defensive action, permit the next stationary primary cast to move for 0.5 seconds per rank within a four-second window. For instant/melee kits, grant 2% movement speed per rank for two seconds instead. Ten-second internal cooldown.

talents.name: Settled Commitment
talents.effect: Primary action: Iron Cut. After two seconds stationary, the next primary output gains 2% per rank. Moving clears preparation. This does not multiply racial offsets or control duration.

talents.name: Resource Reserve
talents.effect: Primary action: Iron Cut. Increase the sustained resource maximum by 2% per rank without refilling it. Does not increase capped marks, summon capacity, damage debt or Combo Points.

talents.name: Scarred Veteran
talents.effect: Each rank increases Rage retained when leaving combat by 3%, within a fixed retention cap.

talents.name: Hampering Blows
talents.effect: Each rank improves Tendon Hook's movement slow by 2 percentage points to its defined cap.

talents.name: Sword and Buckler
talents.effect: Each rank strengthens Iron Brace's mitigation by 1 percentage point, capped in PvP.

talents.name: Formation Drill
talents.effect: Each rank improves the threat generated by melee attacks while near an ally by 3%.

talents.name: Target Transfer
talents.effect: Primary action: Iron Cut. The first eligible primary action against a different valid target costs 3% less per rank; if free, gains 1% output per rank instead. Six-second internal cooldown; retargeting without an action grants nothing.

talents.name: Defensive Follow-through
talents.effect: Primary action: Iron Cut. After real damage is blocked, absorbed or prevented by an owned ability, the next primary action gains 2% output per rank. Ten-second internal cooldown; redirected/debt damage cannot trigger it.

talents.name: Blood and Poise
talents.effect: Each rank grants 2% stronger Iron Cut after a successful Hilt Check for 5 seconds.

talents.name: Rallying Advance
talents.effect: Each rank grants Rally Roar users 1% movement speed for 4 seconds.

talents.name: Hammer and Hook
talents.effect: Each rank increases Hammering Front effectiveness against Tendon Hook targets by 3%.

talents.name: Immovable Veteran
talents.effect: Each rank reduces the cost of Last Bastion by 3% without adding immunity.

talents.name: Conserved Momentum
talents.effect: Primary action: Iron Cut. Retain ordinary combat-generated resource for one additional out-of-combat second per rank before normal decay. Excludes target marks, damage debt, temporary invulnerabilities and instance transfers.

talents.name: Decisive Window
talents.effect: Primary action: Iron Cut. The first direct primary action against an enemy below 25% health, or a healing recipient below 40%, gains 2% output per rank. Six-second internal cooldown; no gain from overhealing or overkill.

talents.name: Efficient Setup
talents.effect: Primary action: Iron Cut. After two distinct successful owned ability families in six seconds, reduce the next paid primary action cost by 2% per rank. One consumption per sequence; periodic ticks are not new families.

talents.name: Extended Setup
